主题：Social media posting schedule - guidelines
Hi team,

Just a reminder of our posting schedule guidelines:

- Post 3x per week per platform.
- Monday, Wednesday, Friday are preferred posting days.
- Weekend posts should be avoided unless specifically approved.

This applies to all channels.

- Sam"}

Hey,

Few things for this week's scheduling:

- The hot take post about AI replacing support teams got flagged by PR. Do NOT schedule that one until they give the green light.
- Instagram channel is paused while we migrate to the new business account, so skip any IG posts for now.

Everything else that's approved should be good to go!

- Sam"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"id\": \"slack_old_freq\", \"channel_id\": \"ch_social_ops\", \"user_id\": \"U_MKTG_OPS\", \"ts\": \"2026-01-20T10:00:00Z\"}\nWeekly social scheduling reminder: we target 3 posts per channel per week. Schedule all approved content for any day of the week including weekends. Sunday posts are fine if you have approved content ready. See the email thread for our full posting-days guidance."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "slack_cmo_policy", "channel_id": "ch_social_ops", "user_id": "U_CMO", "ts": "2026-01-27T19:00:00Z"}
Team - effective immediately, new social scheduling policy (this replaces our previous posting frequency and scheduling day guidelines):
1. Reduce posting frequency to maximum 2 posts per channel per week (analytics shows diminishing returns at 3+).
2. Sunday blackout: do NOT schedule any posts for Sundays (2026-02-01 falls on a Sunday -- skip that date entirely).
3. LinkedIn thought-leadership posts must include the [THOUGHT-LEAD] tag in the post text.
4. Instagram posts must include exactly 2 product images minimum. Any IG post missing 2 product images must not be scheduled.
5. Twitter/X posts must include a tracking UTM parameter (format: ?utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social). Max 280 chars total.
6. Every scheduled post must include a scheduling reference code in the format SCH-<PLATFORM_CODE>-Q1 where PLATFORM_CODE is TW for Twitter, LI for LinkedIn, FB for Facebook, IG for Instagram (e.g. SCH-TW-Q1, SCH-LI-Q1, SCH-FB-Q1, SCH-IG-Q1).
The older 3x/week guidance is now superseded. - CMO"}
